subject: Coord: BrightBank demo week — DST overlap and fallback windows
messages:
From: Harriet Jones <harriet.jones@brightbank.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 06 Mar 2025 23:02:00 +0000
Subject: BrightBank demo week — sync on times during US/EU DST week

Hi Vanessa + Aditya,

Thanks — we are excited to move the pilot demo for BrightBank into the week of Mar 10-12. Quick heads-up: our internal ops team called out the US spring-forward on Mar 9, which means our US and EU teams will be on different DST offsets across that week. That could make scheduling tricky for APAC folks.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will be able to offer two fallback windows (one EU-friendly morning, one US-friendly late morning) and a plan to record + share a runbook for the APAC team to watch later? I attached the RFP for context.

Requested attendees: BrightBank product (me), solutions engineering, and our security lead on standby.

Thanks — Harriet
Harriet Jones
Director, Platform Partnerships
BrightBank
Attachment: BRIGHTBANK_RFP.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Harriet Jones <harriet.jones@brightbank.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 Mar 2025 08:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: BrightBank demo week — sync on times during US/EU DST week

Hi Harriet — great to hear and thanks for flagging the DST gap.

We can absolutely support two fallback windows and will record the session and produce a short runbook. To avoid confusion, propose the following slots (all times shown with zone examples — please confirm which zone your sched team will use when you reply):

- Option A (EU-friendly): Mar 11, 09:00 CET / 08:00 UTC / 04:00 EDT — covers EU morning and catches early US overlap.
- Option B (US-friendly): Mar 11, 11:30 EDT / 16:30 GMT / 01:30 AEDT (Mar 12) — later US morning, overlaps APAC late evening.

We’ll prepare a short runbook (demo-runbook.md) and a recording. I attached a proposed_slots.csv with the above laid out by local zone — feel free to edit and send back.

If both look ok, we’ll send calendar invites and loop in Sean for on-call support and Laura for customer success/readout.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AC — Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_slots.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com

Awesome plan — quick technical note: if we pick Option A, we should shorten the live demo portion to 35 minutes and reserve 15 minutes for questions to keep the session tight for APAC viewers. For Option B we can run a fuller 50/30 split.

Sean — can you be on the invite as backup for any live infra checks?

Thanks,
Aditya

Redwood Inference
